C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear ('Point of sale for Vendure', Live demo / Quick start, 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0'), but the small note 'Your own store needs the plugin on your Vendure server first…' is the only hint that a shop owner cannot just sign up; it's easy to miss under the two big buttons.

C2.worst_defect: The at-the-till payment screenshot shows a cart line named 'Tally Fixture Mug', a test-fixture name that looks out of place next to the real-looking catalogue ('Cold Brew', 'Canvas Apron') used everywhere else.

C3.worst_defect: The docs overview says the till 'signs in to your own Vendure store with an administrator account', while connect-a-till tells you to give each cashier a limited role and to add 'ReadOrder' by hand because the auto-created 'vendurepos-pos-till' role lacks it on 0.3.0. The overview reads as if staff need a full admin login.

C4.worst_defect: The troubleshooting entry for 'N till updates need attention' packs counter advice ('At the counter: leave the app open…'), owner instructions ('For the store owner: copy the refused line… One case you clear at the till by choosing another register, one the till fixes by itself, and for any other code…') and a server errorCode/GraphQL list into one dense block. The actual steps sit behind a collapsed 'To find the line in the sync log'.

C5.worst_defect: The close-the-day (closure) screenshot has thin coloured slivers and cut-off content under the 'Done' button at the image's bottom edge, so it looks badly cropped.

C6.worst_defect: The same closure screenshot shows stray cut-off text under 'Done' on phone. Otherwise tables stack, code wraps and there is no horizontal overflow.

C7.worst_defect: The only failing audits are minor: Lighthouse mobile flags about 52 KiB of unused JS and 140 ms of render-blocking resources, and LCP is 2.5 s on '/', right at the 'good' limit. Titles, descriptions, JSON-LD, llms.txt, search API, sitemap, robots, OG card and the 404 page are all present.

overall_worst.defect: When a till shows 'N till updates need attention', the shop owner lands on a troubleshooting block that mixes counter instructions, owner instructions and a developer errorCode/GraphQL list in one paragraph run. The how-to ('To find the line in the sync log') is collapsed, so the owner can't quickly see what to do at the counter versus what to send to their developer.
overall_worst.fix: Split the entry into three short labelled boxes: 'At the counter' (keep the tab open, keep selling), 'Store owner' (numbered steps to copy the sync-log line, expanded by default), and 'For your developer' (the errorCode list and GraphQL calls).
